# porch_group_parent (Resource)

Nests a group inside a parent group (a DAG of depth ≤ 5): members of the child inherit what the parent is assigned. Import with `<tenant>/<group_id>/<parent_group_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Members of "kids" inherit everything assigned to "family".
resource "porch_group_parent" "kids_in_family" {
  tenant          = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  group_id        = porch_group.kids.id
  parent_group_id = porch_group.family.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the child group. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `parent_group_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the parent group. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<tenant>/<group_id>/<parent_group_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_group_parent.kids_in_family <tenant>/<group_id>/<parent_group_id>
```
